howto.what_en: Adds Slack channel integration via Chat SDK. Copies the adapter & formatting skill, registers, installs pinned dep, builds, tests. With credentials, sends/receives Slack messages via Socket Mode or webhook, resolves your DM channel.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack integration, configure a Slack connection, or during setup flows that need Slack wiring.

say_en.note: Requires a public HTTPS URL and signing secret.
